name: BTC range vs ladder relative value
description: Buys or sells YES in Kalshi's thin hourly BTC range markets when a print proves a quote at least 8c away from the fair value implied by the liquid KXBTCD above/below ladder of the same hour (P(>lo)-P(>hi) from provable ladder mids). Held to settlement.
hypothesis: Both markets settle on the same 60s BRTI average; the ladder is quoted by market makers, the ranges by thin retail books. Research on Sep 22-29 (first full ladder days that are development data): ladder-implied fair has a lower Brier than range prices (0.1620 vs 0.1655); taking range prints that sit >=8c from fair nets +13c/ct (event-clustered se 6, 6,613 prints, 153 hours), >=5c +5c (se 3.4), >=3c +2c. Other side: retail range takers/quoters not tied to the ladder. Wrong if the engine (provable-quote fills, 150 ms, depth) removes it or the CI is <=0. Caveats: 8 days only, one regime, and no ladder data exists after Sep 29, so no lockbox run is possible until Oct+ ladders are downloaded.
